svg.title: Who decides whether the war continues?
svg.desc: Two perspectives with ten picks each. Differ Impact is the weighted score out of 100. Differ Rank orders all twenty arguments from highest to lowest impact. Exact ties use the earlier pick, then the permanent argument ID.
svg.text: Who decides whether the war continues?
Should Congress have to approve continued U.S. fighting in Iran?

g.title: Ralph Terry · Require a public vote · Support · 0
Louise McGee · Allow flexibility with oversight · Support · 1
Public voting record — Show where each lawmaker stands.
